state_machine.entry_actions: Mode=FALSE. Clear automatic route, kick, and CompletionLight; retain firingTemp. Motor outputs are computed from buttons with conflict inhibit.
Motor stopped; kick and CompletionLight cleared; automatic route ready.
Motor stopped; wait for weightComplete. Do not accept weightComplete on the same scan as arrival; evaluate on subsequent scan.

transitions.when: Mode == TRUE AND SensorWeight AND weightComplete AND 100.0 <= weight <= 200.0
Mode == TRUE AND SensorWeight AND weightComplete AND (weight < 100.0 OR weight > 200.0)

state_machine.entry_actions: kick ON; MotorForward OFF; MotorReverse OFF; firingTemp unchanged.
MotorForward ON; MotorReverse OFF; firingTemp holds newly computed accepted value.
CompletionLight ON; MotorForward OFF; MotorReverse OFF. Clear route only after removal.

timer_plan.pt_durations: None; no timed requirement. Confirmations are level-gated by phase; kick and CompletionLight are level states cleared by sensor removal.
timer_plan.optional_edge_timers: If platform uses R_TRIG/one-shot FBs for Mode, buttons, or confirmations, call them unconditionally at top level and reset them on manual entry, Mode change, or route reset.
timer_plan.reset_conditions: Reset all edge/timer FBs on Mode change, entry to MANUAL, safety/reset, or transition to WAIT_FEED.

priorities: Safety interlock: MotorForward and MotorReverse are mutually exclusive; conflicting manual buttons inhibit both outputs.
Mode/manual reset: Mode=FALSE enters MANUAL immediately, clears automatic sequence, kick, CompletionLight, and timers; firingTemp is retained.
Arrival and safety priority: destination sensor stops motion before processing; unqualified weight never proceeds to firing; unrelated completion signals are ignored.

Automatic sequence: at most one phase transition per scan; arrival has priority over matching completion on the same scan; confirmations are accepted only in their corresponding WAIT state on a subsequent scan.
Output unification: assign all outputs once at scan end; enforce interlock last; kick only in REJECT_WAIT; CompletionLight only in OUTPUT_DONE; firingTemp updates only on accepted valid weight.
scan_execution_order: 1. Edge sampling: sample Mode, ForwardButton, ReverseButton, station sensors, washComplete, weightComplete, weight, and firingComplete into shadow registers; compute rising-edge flags and latch pre-phase state for this invocation.

2. Safety/reset priority and state transitions: if Mode=FALSE, enter MANUAL, clear auto route, kick, CompletionLight, and reset timers, retaining firingTemp; otherwise enforce motor interlock, ignore unrelated completions, allow at most one automatic phase transition, give destination arrival priority, and accept a matching completion only in the correct WAIT state and not on the arrival scan.

3. Unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF: call all configured TON/TOF/R_TRIG/one-shot instances unconditionally here; no process timers are required, but any edge/diagnostic timers must be updated every scan and reset by the stage-2 reset conditions.

4. Unified output assignments: assign MotorForward, MotorReverse, kick, CompletionLight, and firingTemp exactly once from the resulting state and manual logic; enforce MotorForward and MotorReverse mutual exclusion as the final interlock; no output writes occur in CASE/IF logic.
